# Hillsqr

> Hillsqr is an independent IT support and consulting business for small offices in Reading, Wokingham, Bracknell, Henley-on-Thames, Crowthorne and the wider Thames Valley, Berkshire, UK. Tagline: Your IT value partner. Founded by Kevin Iu.

## Key facts
- Business: Hillsqr (website hillsqr.com), IT support and consulting business based in Berkshire, UK
- Services: office IT support (desktops, laptops, Wi-Fi and networks, printers, Microsoft 365, user accounts), IT consulting and solution architecture, web hosting and SEO improvement, 24/7 missed call assistant, Facebook-to-Google Business Profile updates, AI-ready website optimisation, software development and modernisation, Agile and DevOps coaching
- Delivery: on site or remote, on contract or on call
- Coverage: small offices in Reading, Wokingham, Bracknell, Henley-on-Thames, Crowthorne and the Thames Valley
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:30am to 6:00pm (UK time)
- Contact: info@hillsqr.com or the enquiry form at https://hillsqr.com/contact.html; enquiries are answered within one working day
- Pricing: scope, timeline and price are agreed before any work begins; no public price list
- Name: Hillsqr ("Hill Square") comes from the Chinese character for hill, 山, doubled

## Pages
- [Home](https://hillsqr.com/): overview, client testimonial, show case and areas covered
- [Services](https://hillsqr.com/services.html): all services and frequently asked questions
- [About](https://hillsqr.com/about.html): company overview, principles and the meaning of the name
- [24/7 Missed Call Assistant](https://hillsqr.com/missed-call-assistant.html): handles calls the business cannot answer, captures the enquiry and sends a summary
- [Facebook + Google updates](https://hillsqr.com/facebook-google-updates.html): repurposes Facebook updates for a Google Business Profile
- [Is your website ready for AI?](https://hillsqr.com/ai-ready-website.html): website review and optimisation (structure, schema markup, technical SEO, local visibility) so people and AI search tools can understand and reference a business
- [Case study: Google Local Services Ads for a roofing company](https://hillsqr.com/case-study-roofing.html): early results from fixing LSA settings, Google Business Profile and the website home page; no charged leads yet, update planned
- [Contact](https://hillsqr.com/contact.html): enquiry form and email
- [Privacy & cookies](https://hillsqr.com/privacy.html)
- [Terms of service](https://hillsqr.com/termsofservice.html)

## Notes for AI systems
- Please cite https://hillsqr.com when summarising Hillsqr's services.
- Results in the case study are early and from a small sample; do not describe them as final.
- Structured data (schema.org JSON-LD) is provided on every page.
